errors.evidence: The chart itself does not have a title. The title 'Справки' is taken from the figure caption provided in the external context, not from the visual content of the image.

errors.evidence: The description interprets 'справки' (references/inquiries) as 'заявки' (requests). While plausible, this is an interpretation of the chart's purpose rather than a direct description of its labels.

The description incorrectly states that the category with the highest value ('друго (посочете какво)') is in the middle group. The chart shows this category is in the third and final group, labeled 'друго'.
